welcome_msg: Welcome, {nickname} 👋 This bot helps you manage dozens of channels at once. Create, edit, and send posts with me 😉 /features — what can I do?
content_msg:
Send content for the post:
Text (photo, video, audio, file, gif) or ↪️ forward a message from another channel.
